faqs.q: Sec. 98-33. - Levy of tax; payment; effective date.
faqs.a:
(a)
There is levied on and against each provider a tax in the amount of $0.455 per line
               each month on the occupation and business of providing basic local exchange service
               at retail to residents of the city.
(b)
All providers shall submit with the tax payment a statement containing the provider's
               current monthly line count as of the last calendar day of the month.
(c)
For each provider, the tax levied by this chapter shall commence on the effective
               date of this article or on the date the provider first provides basic local exchange
               service within the city, whichever is later.
(d)
All providers shall pay this tax each month effective on the last business day of
               each calendar month.
(Code 1981, § 31-18; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
